descriptionHtml:
Suggestion A3 · accessibility · not counted as a bug (was P2): accessibility is not asked for by any UAT item or ticket, so this is a suggestion, not a bug (Quinn 2026-10-14)

Nested buttons: the trash icon and the In Today toggle sit inside the card's own button, so screen readers cannot reach them

Tickets: TFA-92579 · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local (visual check)

Approach · TC-01 Patient Chart Card · S22 Both lists through axe; cards and trash controls have accessible names

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U7 Tapping a card opens that exact patient's Pre-Round view. (UAT TC-01; TFA-92579 AC 5)
  • T5 A patient card can be removed by tapping its trash icon; a pop-up designed like the app UI tells the user what happens if they delete, and the user presses Cancel or OK. (TFA-92579 AC 7)

Test design technique: Accessibility (accessibility) — Check screen-reader, keyboard, contrast and tap-size rules (axe): users with disabilities have to be able to use it too.

Given Standard fixture, visual lane screens hospital-list and nh-list

When Visual lane runs axe-core on both lists

Then Findings are reviewed by a person; each card is a button named 'Open chart for <name>'; each trash control has a name

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Lane V decides nothing: axe findings on hospital-list and nh-list go to a human (visual-checks.ts maps serious/critical to severity 'medium'), and serious/critical ones are routed to TFA-92579. Expected from the code: nested-interactive (serious) on the Hospital card, whose trash <button> sits inside the role="button" card div (PatientCard.tsx); …

Where it ran: local visual lane (screenshots + axe); test method VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); lane planned in the matrix: visual / mobile (automated)

S22 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-01.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row; the Allure status was changed by the triage from passed to failed.

Issue type: Accessibility · environment local · tickets TFA-92579 ready for qa

On the Hospital list the trash button sits inside the card's own button, so a screen-reader user cannot reach 'Remove <patient>' on its own; Nursing Home All Residents has the same problem with the In Today toggle.

Evidence: visual lane, axe nested-interactive (serious) on desktop, iphone15 and pixel7. Record-only per the oracle ('Lane V decides nothing') and routed to TFA-92579 AC 7. 24 of 27 then-clause checks held: every card is 'Open chart for <name>' and every control inside has a name.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane visual.

Test method: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: visual.
